description: Find coin records by their parent coin IDs. Useful for tracing coin lineage — finding all coins created when a parent coin was spent. Optionally filter by spent status and height range.

end_height.description: Only return coins created before this height

include_spent_coins.description: Include coins that have been spent (default: false)

parent_ids.description: Array of parent coin IDs (0x-prefixed, 32 bytes hex each)

start_height.description: Only return coins created at or after this height

name: get_coin_records_by_parent_ids
